fact: Mauritius Telecom says its MyTLearn AI tutor, developed with the Ministry of Education, has completed pilot projects across ten schools nationwide, and it aims to give every secondary school teacher an AI coach by 2027.

Mauritius Telecom's CEO said the operator has piloted an AI learning tool on Rodrigues that lets students learn in Mauritian creole, worked on with the government and education ministry, and refocused it from a student tutor to a tool helping teachers create tests and give feedback.
